thread.title: US STOCKS-Wall Street extends gain after Fed says to be patient on rates

author: Reuters
title: US STOCKS-Wall Street extends gain after Fed says to be patient on rates
text:
© Reuters. US STOCKS-Wall Street extends gain after Fed says to be patient on rates (For a live blog on the U.S. stock market, click LIVE/ or type LIVE/ in a news window)
* Apple jumps on robust services business growth
* Boeing (NYSE: BA ) gains after upbeat earnings, deliveries forecast
* Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN ) boosts consumer discretionary stocks
* Indexes up: Dow 1.51 pct, S&P 0.22 pct, Nasdaq 1.64 pct
(Updates with details after Fed announcement)
By Noel Randewich
Jan 30 (Reuters) - U.S. stocks extended their rally on Wednesday after the Federal Reserve said it would be patient in lifting borrowing costs further this year, reassuring investors worried about a slowing economy.
Along with better-than-feared quarterly results from Apple AAPL.O , the Fed's comments helped Wall Street reverse two down days triggered by profit warnings from U.S. bellwethers that signaled a bigger impact from a slowdown in China.
The Fed held interest rates steady, as widely expected. shares jumped 5.8 percent after reporting a sharp growth in services business, easing concerns after the iPhone maker earlier this month cut current-quarter sales forecast. Co BA.N gained 6.7 percent after the world's largest planemaker forecast full-year profit and cash flow above analysts' estimates amid a boom in air travel and speedier 737 production. the Fed's rate announcement, all three main U.S. stock indexes extended gains from earlier in the session.
At 2:03 p.m. in New York (1903 GMT), the Dow Jones Industrial Average .DJI was up 1.51 percent at 24,951.93, while the S&P 500 .SPX had gained 1.22 percent to 2,672.26.
The Nasdaq Composite .IXIC added 1.64 percent to 7,143.34.
